answer: Pool pay by measured correlation. Each close, the protocol scores every pair of identities on three public signals: answers landing within the same thirty second ridge of block time, identical grades on the same rows, and a shared payout chain. Any cluster matching on 80 percent of rows across ten epochs splits one reward among its members, while each still posts a copper bond of 500 POA. Every grade is signed with the identity's own quill, so its history follows the key, and a farm of n sybils pays n bonds to earn one share.
